title: Choose the room's new world
question: The roll assigned The Broadcast Booth — a dark on-air studio you explore freely. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Broadcast Booth
options.thesis: His Twitch stream made a place: a dark booth you orbit freely — one ON AIR lamp, VU needles breathing with the room, a window of night city light.
options.viewport: You are inside the booth: console faders in silhouette, ON AIR struck red, phosphor trace breathing on the monitor, city through the blinds.
options.risk: Cozy-diarama risk if the room stays small; it must read as a place with air, not a desk render.

raised.raise: Displays draw persistent phosphor traces — a live waveform breathes in the monitor, never HUD chrome.
State changes strike, never tween — ON AIR snaps lit, nothing fades decoratively.
Every control stays present in the room; attention is the only selection, nothing hides behind a menu.
Labels sound like a person wrote them — ON AIR, MONITOR, TALKBACK.
Gear keeps its working marks — tape labels and printed legends, nothing ornamental.

options.label: The Platter Plain
options.thesis: His instrument becomes the terrain: you skate a giant turning platter — strobe dots blurring at the rim, the tonearm a tower, the pitch rail a lit runway.
options.viewport: Low over the platter: grooves sweep past in macro, strobe dots pulse at the edge, the tonearm rises like a crane on the horizon.
options.risk: The familiar DJ icon — strong and legible, but the association every artist site reaches for.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.thesis: A vast hazed hall under one amber half-sun; the ceiling is a mirror and every visitor walks as a silhouette twice — once on the floor, once above.
options.viewport: One long hall in amber mist: a half-disc burns at the far wall, its mirror completes it overhead, tiny silhouettes drift in the haze.
options.case: Wins audience identification — ravers know monumental light. Holds product clarity less well: the hall is sublime but says less about Krid P himself than his own booth.
options.risk: Pure sublime; without his trace inside it, it could belong to any artist.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.case: The waveform is his signal, but a bench is a worktop, not a place a fan wants to stand inside.
options.kept: Persistent phosphor trace — donated to the booth's monitor.

options.label: Cathode Gauze
options.lineage: struck nixie numerals behind wire gauze
options.case: Ghost-numeral depth is beautiful but there is no counting content on a pure-atmosphere surface.
options.kept: States strike, never tween — donated to every lamp in the room.

options.label: Warm App Surface
options.case: An app grammar on an atmosphere surface; the card grammar cannot hold a place you inhabit.
options.kept: Labels written like a person speaks.

options.label: Lotería Tabla
options.case: A game ritual for a listening room — wrong ceremony for this crowd.
options.kept: One drawn card at a time — the room holds one focus.

options.label: Quote Grammar
options.case: Merch-tag irony is a shop, not a room; the product here is a place to stand in.
options.kept: Gear keeps its working marks — tape labels, printed legends.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every artist site ships as a 3D space: a dark neon room, logo center, orbits a product render.
canonCard.viewport: A neon-lit void with the logo floating center, camera slowly orbiting.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other artist page by design.
